content: पुरस्कृ €8 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To place before or in front, make oneʼs leader, put at the head; हते जरति गाङ्गेये पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम् <ls>Ve. 2. 4</ls>; <ls>U. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 52</ls>. .²2 To introduce, present; मद्वचनात् स राजा शकुन्तलां पुरस्कृत्य वक्तव्यः <ls>Ś. 4</ls>, <ls n="Ś.">7</ls>. .²3 To honour, respect, esteem, hospitably receive or entertain; दर्शनेनैव भवतीनां पुरस्कृतोऽस्मि <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. .²4 To adopt, choose, follow; स पुरस्कृतमध्यमक्रमः <ls>R. 8. 9</ls>. .²5 To appoint. .²6 To show, indicate, evince. .²7 To lead. .²8 To use as a pretext.
